verdict.rationale: Canny ships a changelog product for announcing shipped updates (canny-docs-8, canny-docs-14). It also documents embeddable widgets for websites and mobile apps (canny-docs-17, canny-docs-18). However, none of the evidence states that the embeddable widget shows the changelog inside your product rather than the feedback board. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an embeddable in-app changelog widget, details on installing and customizing it, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
